title: Gem Cascade
core_loop: Player swaps adjacent gems to create matches of 3+ identical colors. Matched gems disappear, gems above fall down to fill gaps, and new gems spawn from the top. Cascading matches award bonus points. Player must reach a target score within a limited number of moves.
controls: Click/tap on a gem, then click/tap an adjacent gem (up/down/left/right) to swap them. Only swaps that create a valid match are allowed. Alternatively, click and drag a gem to an adjacent position.
mechanics: 8x8 grid of gems in 6 different colors (rendered as colored circles with gradients)
Swap adjacent gems horizontally or vertically
Match 3 or more identical gems in a row/column to clear them
Gravity pulls gems down to fill empty spaces
New random gems spawn at the top to fill the board
Cascading chain reactions award 2x, 3x, 4x multiplier bonuses
Limited move counter decreases with each swap
Target score must be reached before moves run out
Only allow swaps that result in valid matches (no dead swaps)
juice: Smooth lerp animation for swapping gems (200ms)
Matched gems scale down and fade out before disappearing
Falling gems animate smoothly with easing
Score popup numbers float upward and fade at match location
Chain multiplier text displays prominently with color intensity based on multiplier
Matched gems flash white briefly before destruction
Canvas background gradient shifts hue slightly on successful matches
Move counter pulses red when below 5 moves remaining
Particle burst effect (small colored circles radiating outward) on matches
mvp_scope: Single endless-style level with a target score of 1000 points and 20 moves. 8x8 grid with 6 gem colors. Basic match-3 mechanics with gravity and cascading. Procedurally drawn gems using canvas circles with radial gradients. Score tracking, move counter, and win/lose screen with restart button. All rendering, physics, and game logic in one HTML file with inline JavaScript and CSS.
win_lose_condition: WIN: Reach 1000 points before running out of moves. LOSE: Moves reach zero before achieving target score. Game displays win/lose message overlay with final score and a 'Play Again' button that resets the game state.
